meta.name: lsp
meta.description: Use when Codex needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks in the current workspace.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在编辑器中获取代码诊断、定义跳转和引用查找
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代码编辑器中快速定位定义、引用或检查重命名安全
copy.tagline_en: Get language diagnostics, definitions, references, and rename safety in your editor
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick access to definitions, references, and rename safety in your code editor

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 可直接调用 lsp 工具:查看语言服务器状态、检查文件或目录的诊断、跳转定义、查找引用、列出符号,以及校验和执行重命名。
howto.when: 当需要在当前工作区获取语言服务器诊断、定义、引用、符号或重命名安全校验时触发。

say.text: 用 lsp.status 看下当前配置了哪些语言服务器
say.note: 列出已配置、已安装、缺失与活动的服务器

say.text: 检查 src/index.ts 的诊断,只看 error
say.note: 返回该文件的 error 级诊断

say.text: 查一下这个符号在整个工作区的引用
say.note: 列出该符号的所有使用位置

howto.what_en: Claude can call the lsp tools directly: list language-server status, check file or directory diagnostics, go to definitions, find references, list symbols, and validate or apply renames.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the current workspace needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks.

say_en.text: Run lsp.status to see which language servers are configured
say_en.note: Lists configured, installed, missing and active servers

say_en.text: Check diagnostics for src/index.ts, errors only
say_en.note: Returns error-level diagnostics for that file

say_en.text: Find all references to this symbol in the workspace
say_en.note: Lists every usage of the symbol
